text.tspan: IAM: a policy is the permission document; a role is an assumable identity holding policies
2. Any explicit Deny anywhere (identity, resource, SCP, boundary) → DENIED, always wins
3. Organizations SCP, permissions boundary, session policy: must ALSO allow (they only limit, never grant)
4. An Allow in an identity policy or a resource policy (e.g. S3 bucket policy) → ALLOWED
Cross-account: BOTH sides must allow (role/user policy in A + resource policy or trust in B)
Policy types: AWS managed · customer managed · inline · resource-based (bucket policy, KMS key policy)
